overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a targeted, highly engaged academic and professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases, and research opportunities, generating strong engagement particularly among specialized academic audiences.

contentThemes.description: Research findings, tools (CooRnet), and conference talks around detecting coordinated manipulation.
Sharing grant awards, newly published papers, and upcoming conference presentations.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and research opportunities for PhD students.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency across all platforms to maintain momentum from high-performing announcements.
Cross-promote major research breakthroughs with visual media or link previews to further boost click-throughs and engagement.
Engage directly in conversation threads, particularly on Bluesky and Mastodon where repost rates are strong.
Utilize LinkedIn for professional milestones and hiring, while leveraging Bluesky and Mastodon for real-time academic discussion and networking.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest average engagement rate driven by strong amplification (reposts) on academic research and opportunity posts.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche, academic-focused audience showing steady engagement on tool releases and methodological discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute engagement numbers (likes and comments), making it optimal for career opportunities and grant announcements.
